assessments.decision: The production release window is set to Friday afternoon, from 14:00 to 16:00 Singapore time.
assessments.why: The new decision moves ordinary release slots to Tuesday and Thursday mornings and bans Friday production deploys, which directly contradicts The production release window is set to Friday afternoon, from 14:00 to 16:00 Singapore time by Anika Rao and explicitly supersedes it as the outcome of the review.
